Join AYBL as a Warehouse Operative and start immediately!

Looking for temporary full-time work with a fast-growing international sportswear brand? Join AYBL in Halfweg and earn €15.42 gross per hour while working daytime shifts from Monday to Friday. This temporary assignment starts immediately and offers the possibility of extension.

Are you looking for a temporary warehouse job near Amsterdam, Haarlem, or Hoofddorp? AYBL is looking for motivated Warehouse Operatives to support its busy distribution centre during a peak operational period.

As a Warehouse Operative, you will play an important role in ensuring that customer orders are processed quickly and accurately. Working as part of a dynamic team, you will contribute to the efficient flow of goods throughout the warehouse.

Your responsibilities include:

• Order Picking: Using a handheld scanner to collect sportswear and accessories for customer orders.• Packing & Shipping: Checking products, carefully packing orders, and applying shipping labels.• Stock Management: Replenishing stock locations, processing incoming deliveries, and assisting with inventory counts.• Returns Processing: Inspecting returned products and handling them according to warehouse procedures.

You will work in a modern distribution centre where teamwork, accuracy, and productivity are highly valued.

- Available from 7 September for a temporary assignment of at least 2 weeks
- Available full-time (37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday)
- Physically fit and comfortable standing and walking throughout the day
- Accurate, reliable, and motivated to work in a fast-paced environment
- Basic English communication skills for instructions and scanner usage

Are you looking for a job to combine with your studies or family life? Then we have a great opportunity for you! For our warehouse in Ede, we are looking for an order picker and packer for the morning and afternoon shifts. You start your workday by receiving and checking incoming goods. Next you make sure that products are stored in the correct location in the warehouse. Using modern systems such as hand scanners and voice picking, you collect orders. You check if everything is correct and prepare the order for shipment. During your work, you are constantly on the move and actively contribute to a smooth logistics process!

You work in a 2 shift system:

- 07:00 – 16:00 (morning shift)
- 16:00 – 00:00 (afternoon shift)

These two shifts alternate weekly. Additionally, you work one Saturday every four weeks.

- You can speak English or Dutch
- You are available for at least 2 working days per week
- You are willing to work in a 2-shift system
- You are physically capable of performing active work, such as walking and lifting
- Experience is not required, but motivation and commitment are important

As a woodworker, you will be working at a modern and stable high-tech company in Eindhoven. You will be responsible on a daily basis for dismantling and reassembling wooden transport crates for large and fragile high-tech components. You will do this based on technical drawings and fixed work instructions.

You will check the quality of the work, identify deviations, and work according to applicable safety regulations. The position is carried out in a two-shift system (06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00) and offers full-time employment with the prospect of a permanent contract.

- Technical insight and experience with woodworking (e.g. machine or manual woodworking, assembly, or production).
- VMBO level of working and thinking.
- Experience in reading technical drawings.
- Ability to work accurately with a strong focus on quality.
- Willingness to work in a two-shift system (06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00).
- Good command of the English language.
- Team player and living in the Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven, Veghel, or Valkenswaard area.

Accurate, quality-driven, and a calm, collaborative team player: does this sound like you? Then we have the perfect job for you! For our site, we are looking for a meticulous GMP Operator who will work together with the team to ensure medical products are prepared for the market to perfection.

What we offer
- Hourly wage of € 15,40 per hour!
- A full-time job for a longer period of time!
- Working on Mon-Fri from 7am-4pm!
- Travel allowance up to € 7,45 per day!
- Pension from day 1!

Who you are
You are an organized and detail-oriented professional who thrives both working independently and within a small team. You stay calm under pressure, follow oral and written instructions accurately, and take full ownership of product quality.

- Professional English skills (reading, writing, and speaking);
- Working knowledge of computer systems, specifically MS Office;
- Strong communication skills and a calm, collaborative mindset;
- A sharp eye for detail and administrative accuracy.

What will you do
AAs a GMP Operator, you play a key role in adapting and modifying (rework) medical products to meet specific customer requirements. Your daily routine is a dynamic mix of careful planning, paperwork, and hands-on physical rework in a restricted cleanroom environment.

Your tasks are both administrative and hands-on, partly carried out in a restricted cleanroom environment. You’ll collaborate closely with colleagues, the QA department, and communicate regularly with customers.

- Creating paperwork, filling out forms, and generating labels;
- Peer validating your colleagues' work to guarantee that all procedures and quality standards are met;
-  Performing actual product modifications in a restricted cleanroom environment;
-  Collaborating with your team to keep the work area organized, manage records retention, and order necessary materials.

Where will you work

Looking for a job where you stay active and earn a great salary? At GXO in Heerlen, you’ll work in a modern warehouse for well-known brands like Zara, H&M, Primark, IKEA, and Ahold. You make sure every order is ready on time.

As a warehouse worker, you keep everything running smoothly:

- Picking orders like clothing and shoes
- Packing items carefully and preparing them for shipment
- Helping to keep stock organized

You’ll work full-time in a 2-shift system (morning and afternoon). The schedule is clear and planned in advance, so you always know what to expect.

- You can speak and read English
- You have your own transport to GXO Heerlen
- You’re available fulltime in 2 shifts
- Experience in logistics is nice, but not required (GXO teach you everything)

Are you a true go-getter with leadership experience in logistics? Do you know how to motivate a team and ensure that everything runs smoothly on the shop floor? Then we’re looking for you!

As a Warehouse Team Leader, you’ll be the first point of contact for your team. You’ll actively participate on the shop floor, manage your colleagues, and ensure that daily logistics processes are carried out safely, efficiently, and according to schedule.

What will you do?
As a Warehouse Team Leader, you will lead a team of approximately 5 to 15 warehouse employees and temporary workers. Together, you make sure all warehouse activities are completed safely, efficiently, and on time.

Your responsibilities include:

- Coordinating daily inbound, storage, order picking, and outbound activities.
- Leading, coaching, and supporting warehouse employees on the work floor.
- Monitoring productivity, quality, and safety standards.
- Ensuring accurate administrative processing in the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
- Reporting operational issues and supporting continuous process improvements.
- Working closely with the Warehouse Supervisor and Customer Service to achieve daily operational targets.
- Helping to create a safe, clean, and organized working environment.

You are a hands-on leader who enjoys working in a fast-paced warehouse environment and knows how to motivate a team.

You also have:

- An MBO Level 3 qualification, preferably in Logistics.
- At least 2 years of experience in a supervisory role within logistics or manufacturing.
- Experience working in a warehouse environment.
- Good communication skills in English (Dutch is an advantage).
- A proactive attitude and strong organizational skills.
- A focus on safety, quality, and teamwork.
- A valid Certificate of Conduct (VOG). If your VOG is approved, Olympia will reimburse the cost of €41.35. If your VOG is not approved, the cost will be at your own expense.
- You have your own accommodation;

About the job

Are you precise, motivated, and do you enjoy working in a clean and well-organized environment? As a Cleanroom Operator, you will make sure that components are carefully cleaned, inspected, and packaged for customers in the high-tech industry.This is a varied position where accuracy, quality, and teamwork are key.

What will you do?

In this role, you will work in a cleanroom environment where precision and quality are essential. You will work with customers from the high-tech, medical, automotive, and aerospace industries — sectors where there is no room for error and where your work directly contributes to the final product.As a Cleanroom Operator, you will play an important role in cleaning, inspecting, and packaging components. You will work according to clear protocols and detailed work instructions.

Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning components using modern machines or manually
- (Dis)assembling components based on technical drawings
- Performing detailed quality inspections, including inspections using UV lamps
Packaging components in the cleanroom to ensure they arrive at the customer in perfect condition

You will work in a modern, safe, and well-organized environment where teamwork and quality are highly valued.

What are we looking for?

- MBO-level education or equivalent working and thinking level
- Experience in a cleanroom or assembly environment is a plus, but not required — we are happy to train you
- Good command of English; Dutch is a plus
- You work accurately and independently and have a flexible attitude
- You are available to work in shifts: 06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00
- You don't meet all the requirements but think this position could be a good fit for you? We would still love to hear from you!

Are you an experienced logistics employee with valid certificates and looking for a new challenge? For one of our clients, we are looking for motivated logistics staff who can work both independently and as part of a team.

Key Responsibilities

- Load, unload and move goods within the Service Centre using a forklift, reach truck, stacker or other transport equipment.
- Receive, store and process incoming goods, including the related administrative tasks.
- Manage internal product movements and maintain accurate inventory levels.
- Ensure product quality while following all safety, environmental and housekeeping procedures.

The job runs in a 2-shift rotation: one week from Monday to Friday, 06:00–15:00, followed by a week from Monday to Friday, 15:00–00:00.

- Proven experience in logistics (required)
- Valid certificate for:
- EPT (Electric Pallet Truck)
- Forklift
- Stacker
- Minimum English level A2 (spoken and written)
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift system
- Accurate, motivated, and reliable
- Able to work both independently and as part of a team

Are you looking for an active warehouse job that fits perfectly with your personal life? Then this is your chance! We are currently looking for motivated order pickers and packers who can start immediately and are available for both morning and afternoon shifts. Using modern tools such as hand scanners and voice picking, you will collect orders quickly and accurately. You make sure every order is complete and ready for shipment.

In this role, you will stay active throughout the day and play an important part in keeping the logistics process running smoothly.

Working hours (2 shift system):

- Morning: 07:00 – 16:00
- Afternoon: 16:00 – 00:00

- You speak English or Dutch
- You are available at least 2 days per week
- You are willing to work in a 2 shift system
- You are physically able to perform active work (standing, walking, lifting)
- No experience is required, motivation are most important
- Resident of the Netherlands
- Valid work permit for the Netherlands required
- No housing available

As a production worker, you’ll join a dynamic department equipped with multiple machines and over 30 colleagues working in a 3-shift system. You’ll be involved in the entire production process — from start to finished products. Think: peanut butter in all kinds of varieties, made for a wide range of customers. If you have a technical mindset (or are eager to learn!), you’ll fit right in!

Your daily responsibilities as a production worker include:

- Operating and setting up the machines that produce our products

- Troubleshooting minor technical issues

- Performing basic maintenance on the machines

- Testing the final products for quality and consistency

3-shift system (06:00–14:15 and 14:00–22:15 and 22.00 - 6.15

Requirements for working as an production worker:

- Willingness to work in a production environment (including exposure to food products)

- Basic understanding of English or Dutch

- you´ve allready worked or show intressed In a production enviorment 

- Willing to help your co-workers on the production line 

We do not provide accomodations. You need to live in the serroundings of Giessen.

GID International B.V. is searching for procurement specialists to be engaged on a permanent, fulltime 
 basis and willing to travel for short-term and medium-term assignments. 
GID is a worldwide operating procurement and purchasing firm -established in 1988- with its 
headquarters based in the Netherlands. GID has gained long-standing experience and worldwide 
reputation in the implementation of international public procurement in a broad variety of sectors. 
Major clients of GID include bi- and multilateral donor organizations and private sector clients, 
among which multinationals and international contracting companies. 
Activities can be divided as follows: 
• In the Netherlands or home-based: 
o procurement and purchasing activities; 
o preparation of proposals; and 
• Abroad: 
o project related procurement activities for donor funded projects. 
Language abilities: candidates have to be at least English speaking. 
In case you are interested, you are requested to send an application letter, CV in World Bank format 
and contact details of at least three references who might be contacted.

As a Sheet Metal Worker, you carry out repairs and maintenance work on aircraft components. You work precisely, following fixed specifications and using professional tools. 

Good to know: around 20-30% of your work is administrative. This includes reading and working with technical drawings and manuals, in English. You'll switch between these two sides of the trade throughout the day: working with your hands, and carefully reading documentation.

- MBO+ level of thinking and working: good with your hands, with an eye for detail and patience for the administrative side
- Open to recently graduated with internship experience
- You have an affinity for sheet metal work or metalworking (e.g. as an automotive body repair technician)
- You can read and understand English well (technical drawings and manuals are in English)
- You don't have a 9 to 5 mentality and are open to work in the evening or weekends if needed (after 8 months of employment)
